failures.root_cause: sw-cleanup.sh dry-run does not detect stale heartbeats or print Found/--force summary hints
failures.fix: Fix sw-cleanup.sh to detect stale heartbeat files from the temp dir and print a summary line with 'Found N item(s)' and '--force' hint when items are found in dry-run mode

failures.root_cause: sed command attempting to read a file path instead of an inline expression — missing -e flag or incorrect argument order caused sed to interpret the substitution string as a filename
failures.fix: change `sed 's|...|...|g'` call to use `-e` flag or ensure the expression is passed as an argument rather than a filename: `sed -e 's|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g'`
